1 /**
2  * Deterministic dispatch table (W4).
3  * phase × uncertainty × human_wait × cost → LITE|FULL|SPIKE|commission|refuse
4  *
5  * Defaults bias LITE. SPIKE for unknown data shape. FULL only when a cell says so.
6  * refuse when human_wait blocks or out-of-scope. capacity=unknown → LITE bias flag
7  * (never silent FULL green). depth-suggest reads Strip signals + this table only.
8  */
9 
10 import { loadDispatchTableSeed } from './load.mjs';

23   'human_wait',
24   'cost',
25 ]);
26

113 /**
114  * Load dispatch table (fixture seed + builtins). Fixture cells win on equal specificity
115  * when listed first; builtins fill gaps.
116  * @param {{ table?: object, cells?: object[] }} [opts]
117  */
118 export function loadDispatchTable(opts = {}) {
119   if (opts.table && typeof opts.table === 'object') {
120     return normalizeTable(opts.table);
121   }
122   if (Array.isArray(opts.cells)) {
123     return normalizeTable({
124       schema: 'ecgberht-dispatch-table-seed-v0',
125       bias: DEFAULT_BIAS,
126       outcomes: [...DISPATCH_OUTCOMES],
127       dimensions: [...DISPATCH_DIMENSIONS],
128       cells: opts.cells,
129     });
130   }
131   let seed = null;
132   try {
133     seed = loadDispatchTableSeed();
134   } catch {
135     seed = null;
136   }
137   return normalizeTable(seed);
138 }
139 
140 /**
141  * @param {object|null} raw
142  */
143 export function normalizeTable(raw) {
144   const cells = [];
145   const seen = new Set();
146   const push = (list) => {
147     for (const c of list || []) {
148       if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') continue;
149       const outcome = normalizeOutcome(c.outcome);
150       if (!outcome) continue;
151       const key = cellKey(c);
152       if (seen.has(key)) continue;
153       seen.add(key);
154       cells.push({
155         phase: normDim(c.phase, 'any'),
156         uncertainty: normDim(c.uncertainty, 'any'),
157         human_wait: normDim(c.human_wait, 'any'),
158         cost: normDim(c.cost, 'any'),
159         outcome,
160         why: typeof c.why === 'string' ? c.why : null,
161       });
162     }
163   };
164   // Fixture / caller cells first (higher priority on equal specificity via stable sort)
165   push(raw?.cells);
166   push(BUILTIN_CELLS);
167 
168   return {
169     schema: raw?.schema ?? 'ecgberht-dispatch-table-seed-v0',
170     spelling: 'Ecgberht',
171     bias: raw?.bias === 'FULL' ? 'LITE' : DEFAULT_BIAS, // hard LITE bias — never flip default to FULL
172     outcomes: [...DISPATCH_OUTCOMES],
173     dimensions: [...DISPATCH_DIMENSIONS],
174     capacity_rule: raw?.capacity_rule ?? {
175       when: 'unknown',
176       effect: ['rank_penalty', 'LITE_bias_flag'],
177       forbid: 'silent_green',
178     },
179     cells,
180     table_ready: true,
181   };
182 }
183 
184 function normDim(v, fallback = 'any') {
185   if (v == null || v === '') return fallback;
186   return String(v).toLowerCase();
187 }
188 
189 function normalizeOutcome(v) {
190   if (v == null) return null;
191   const s = String(v).trim();
192   const upper = s.toUpperCase();
193   if (upper === 'LITE' || upper === 'FULL' || upper === 'SPIKE') return upper;
194   const lower = s.toLowerCase();
195   if (lower === 'commission' || lower === 'refuse') return lower;
196   return null;
197 }
198 
199 function cellKey(c) {
200   return [c.phase, c.uncertainty, c.human_wait, c.cost, c.outcome]
201     .map((x) => String(x ?? 'any').toLowerCase())
202     .join('|');
203 }
204 
205 /**
206  * Extract dispatch dimensions + flags from Strip (or plain signal object).
207  * Reads Strip signals only — no free-form depth inflation.
208  * @param {object|null} stripOrSignals
209  * @returns {object}
210  */
211 export function extractDispatchSignals(stripOrSignals = null) {
212   const s = stripOrSignals && typeof stripOrSignals === 'object' ? stripOrSignals : {};
213   const flags = Array.isArray(s.uncertainty_flags) ? [...s.uncertainty_flags] : [];
214   const capacity = s.capacity === 'known' ? 'known' : s.capacity === 'unknown' ? 'unknown' : s.capacity ?? null;
215 
216   const phase = s.phase != null && s.phase !== '' ? String(s.phase).toLowerCase() : 'any';
217 
218   let human_wait = 'none';
219   const hw = s.human_wait;
220   if (hw != null && String(hw).trim() !== '' && String(hw).toLowerCase() !== 'none') {
221     // any non-none wait blocks ceremony (approval, blocked, waiting, …)
222     human_wait = 'blocked';
223   }
224 
225   // capacity_* flags are capacity signals, not ceremony-uncertainty levels
226   const ceremonyFlags = flags.filter((f) => !/capacity/i.test(String(f)));
227 
228   let uncertainty =
229     s.uncertainty != null && s.uncertainty !== ''
230       ? String(s.uncertainty).toLowerCase()
231       : null;
232   if (!uncertainty) {
233     if (
234       ceremonyFlags.some((f) =>
235         /^(high|uncertainty_high|high_uncertainty)$/i.test(String(f)) ||
236         /unknown_shape|data_shape|high.?risk|trust_surface|false.?liquidity/i.test(
237           String(f),
238         ),
239       )
240     ) {
241       uncertainty = 'high';
242     } else if (ceremonyFlags.some((f) => /medium|moderate/i.test(String(f)))) {
243       uncertainty = 'medium';
244     } else if (ceremonyFlags.length === 0) {
245       uncertainty = 'low';
246     } else {
247       uncertainty = 'medium';
248     }
249   }
250 
251   let cost =
252     s.cost != null && s.cost !== ''
253       ? String(s.cost).toLowerCase()
254       : null;
255   if (!cost) {
256     if (
257       flags.some((f) =>
258         /unknown_shape|data_shape|unknown_data|unknown.?shape/i.test(String(f)),
259       ) ||
260       s.data_shape === 'unknown' ||
261       s.unknown_data_shape === true
262     ) {
263       cost = 'unknown_shape';
264     } else if (
265       flags.some((f) =>
266         /out_of_scope|out-of-scope|oos/i.test(String(f)),
267       ) ||
268       s.out_of_scope === true
269     ) {
270       cost = 'out_of_scope';
271     } else if (
272       flags.some((f) =>
273         /high_cost|expensive|trust_surface|multi.?phase|platform/i.test(String(f)),
274       )
275     ) {
276       cost = 'high';
277     } else {
278       cost = 'low';
279     }
280   }
281 
282   const capacity_unknown = capacity === 'unknown';
283   // Table defaults LITE; capacity=unknown strengthens LITE bias flag (never silent green)
284   const flags_out = {
285     lite_bias: true,
286     capacity_unknown,
287     silent_full_green: false,
288     unknown_data_shape: cost === 'unknown_shape',
289     human_wait_blocked: human_wait === 'blocked',
290   };
291 
292   return {
293     phase,
294     uncertainty,
295     human_wait,
296     cost,
297     capacity: capacity ?? 'unknown',
298     uncertainty_flags: flags,
299     active_effort: s.active_effort ?? null,
300     tool_depth_cell: s.tool_depth_cell ?? null,
301     flags: flags_out,
302   };
303 }
304 
305 /**
306  * Specificity score: more concrete dims beat wildcards.
307  * @param {object} cell
308  */
309 export function cellSpecificity(cell) {
310   let n = 0;
311   for (const d of DISPATCH_DIMENSIONS) {
312     const v = cell[d];
313     if (v != null && String(v).toLowerCase() !== 'any') n += 1;
314   }
315   return n;
316 }
317 
318 /**
319  * Whether a table cell matches normalized dimensions.
320  * @param {object} cell
321  * @param {object} dims
322  */
323 export function cellMatches(cell, dims) {
324   for (const d of DISPATCH_DIMENSIONS) {
325     const cv = cell[d];
326     if (cv == null || String(cv).toLowerCase() === 'any') continue;
327     if (String(cv).toLowerCase() !== String(dims[d]).toLowerCase()) return false;
328   }
329   return true;
330 }
331 
332 /**
333  * Lookup outcome for dimensions against a table.
334  * @param {object} dims extractDispatchSignals result or plain dims
335  * @param {{ table?: object }} [opts]
336  * @returns {object}
337  */
338 export function lookupDispatch(dims, opts = {}) {
339   const table = opts.table ?? loadDispatchTable(opts);
340   const d = {
341     phase: normDim(dims.phase, 'any'),
342     uncertainty: normDim(dims.uncertainty, 'low'),
343     human_wait: normDim(dims.human_wait, 'none'),
344     cost: normDim(dims.cost, 'low'),
345   };
346 
347   const matches = (table.cells || []).filter((c) => cellMatches(c, d));
348   matches.sort((a, b) => cellSpecificity(b) - cellSpecificity(a));
349 
350   let cell = matches[0] ?? null;
351   let outcome = cell ? cell.outcome : DEFAULT_BIAS;
352   let why = cell?.why ?? (cell ? `table cell → ${outcome}` : 'default LITE bias (no matching cell)');
353   let matched = Boolean(cell);
354   const flags = {
355     lite_bias: true,
356     capacity_unknown: dims.capacity === 'unknown' || dims.flags?.capacity_unknown === true,
357     silent_full_green: false,
358     unknown_data_shape: d.cost === 'unknown_shape' || dims.flags?.unknown_data_shape === true,
359     human_wait_blocked: d.human_wait === 'blocked',
360     demoted_from_full: false,
361     table_default: !matched,
362   };
363 
364   // capacity=unknown: never silent FULL green — demote FULL → LITE with flag
365   if (flags.capacity_unknown && outcome === 'FULL') {
366     flags.demoted_from_full = true;
367     why = `${why}; capacity=unknown demotes FULL → LITE (never silent FULL green)`;
368     outcome = 'LITE';
369   }
370 
371   // LITE bias flag on LITE outcomes, capacity-unknown, or unmatched default
372   flags.lite_bias =
373     outcome === 'LITE' || flags.capacity_unknown || flags.table_default;
374 
375   // Explicit: never report silent FULL green
376   flags.silent_full_green = false;
377 
378   const tool_depth_why = buildToolDepthWhy({ outcome, why, dims: d, flags, cell });
379 
380   return {
381     ok: true,
382     table_ready: true,
383     outcome,
384     cell: cell
385       ? {
386           phase: cell.phase,
387           uncertainty: cell.uncertainty,
388           human_wait: cell.human_wait,
389           cost: cell.cost,
390           outcome: cell.outcome,
391           why: cell.why,
392         }
393       : {
394           phase: d.phase,
395           uncertainty: d.uncertainty,
396           human_wait: d.human_wait,
397           cost: d.cost,
398           outcome: DEFAULT_BIAS,
399           why: 'default LITE bias',
400           synthetic: true,
401         },
402     dimensions: d,
403     flags,
404     why,
405     tool_depth_why,
406     bias: DEFAULT_BIAS,
407     matched,
408   };
409 }
410 
411 /**
412  * Full suggest path: Strip signals → table → structured cell (no free-form).
413  * @param {object|null} stripOrSignals
414  * @param {{ table?: object }} [opts]
415  */
416 export function suggestDepthFromStrip(stripOrSignals, opts = {}) {
417   const signals = extractDispatchSignals(stripOrSignals);
418   const result = lookupDispatch(signals, opts);
419   const uncertainty_flags = [...signals.uncertainty_flags];
420   if (
421     result.flags.capacity_unknown &&
422     !uncertainty_flags.includes('capacity_unknown')
423   ) {
424     uncertainty_flags.push('capacity_unknown');
425   }
426   if (result.flags.lite_bias && !uncertainty_flags.includes('LITE_bias')) {
427     uncertainty_flags.push('LITE_bias');
428   }
429 
430   return {
431     ...result,
432     signals,
433     uncertainty_flags,
434     capacity: signals.capacity,
435   };
436 }
437 
438 function buildToolDepthWhy({ outcome, why, dims, flags, cell }) {
439   const parts = [
440     `outcome=${outcome}`,
441     `phase=${dims.phase}`,
442     `uncertainty=${dims.uncertainty}`,
443     `human_wait=${dims.human_wait}`,
444     `cost=${dims.cost}`,
445   ];
446   if (flags.capacity_unknown) parts.push('capacity=unknown→LITE_bias');
447   if (flags.unknown_data_shape) parts.push('unknown_data_shape→SPIKE_path');
448   if (flags.demoted_from_full) parts.push('demoted_FULL');
449   if (cell?.why) parts.push(cell.why);
450   else if (why) parts.push(why);
451   return parts.join('; ');
452 }
453 
454 /**
455  * Apply a human override of table outcome. Requires structured reason fields.
456  * Does not mutate table — returns override envelope for receipt-validate.
457  * @param {string} fromOutcome
458  * @param {string} toOutcome
459  * @param {{ who: string, when: string, why: string }} reason
460  */
461 export function applyDepthOverride(fromOutcome, toOutcome, reason = {}) {
462   const from = normalizeOutcome(fromOutcome);
463   const to = normalizeOutcome(toOutcome);
464   const issues = [];
465   if (!from) issues.push('override.from required (valid outcome)');
466   if (!to) issues.push('override.to required (valid outcome)');
467   for (const key of ['who', 'when', 'why']) {
468     if (reason[key] == null || reason[key] === '') {
469       issues.push(`override.${key} required`);
470     }
471   }
472   if (issues.length) {
473     return {
474       ok: false,
475       error: 'override_receipt_required',
476       message: `Human override requires structured receipt reason (who/when/why/from→to): ${issues.join('; ')}`,
477       issues,
478     };
479   }
480   return {
481     ok: true,
482     outcome: to,
483     override: {
484       who: reason.who,
485       when: reason.when,
486       why: reason.why,
487       from,
488       to,
489     },
490     tool_depth_why: `human override ${from}→${to}: ${reason.why}`,
491   };
492 }
